rationale.conceptual: The method combines standard event-driven molecular dynamics with a well-documented but non-trivial adaptation for hard squares (collision detection for axis-aligned squares). The phase transition prediction from free-volume and Padé approximant requires understanding of statistical thermodynamics and numerical integration. It is not a novel algorithm but demands careful implementation of a multi-component, domain-specific protocol.
rationale.execution: The pipeline consists of only three sequential steps: compute the transition coexistence analytically, run the MD simulations for 16 state points, and post-process the pressure data. All steps use standard Python/NumPy libraries, with straightforward file I/O (CSV, JSON). No external data acquisition, complex orchestration, or fragile tooling is involved.
